scope: Read-only audit of isolated native guarded direct-hit lookahead. No production modification, runtime test execution or physical closure claim.
conclusion: No unsound rule-admission path found. Bounded candidate fallback and final coverage preservation are different contracts; only the former is promised.

findings.detail: The exact retained direct candidate is returned on extra-row budget, selected-trace budget, depth exhaustion or seed exhaustion. Arithmetic, power, modular sample, lifting and canonicalization failures intentionally propagate. The audit initially flagged these propagated errors against an unconditional fallback reading; root explicitly clarified that suppressing such failures is forbidden.

A strictly smaller indirect candidate or later direct zero is selected before guarded replay/descent sealing, RHS sign refinement and condition exception handling. It can introduce stronger conditions, more domain splits, a certification failure or a coupled exceptional gap, thereby losing baseline coverage. No invalid proof is accepted: unchanged sealing still rejects it. This initial experiment must record all conditions/failures and must not claim coverage preservation. Retaining fallback through final guarded admission is a separate production design if results justify it.

At most512 additional source attempts after the first nonzero direct hit; charge occurs before guard rejection and empty-row projection. Selected indirect replay input is capped at64rows/16384terms. Over-budget tracing returns the complete retained direct candidate, never a truncated proof. Baseline search before the first hit remains uncapped apart from existing depth controls; exact coefficient arithmetic/wall time is not bounded by these input-size caps.

Original guarded source ordinals/seeds and same immutable scope are retained. Alternative modular pivots are lifted exactly, then independently sealed from original source rows. Source conditions, rational denominators, domain pullbacks, uniform zero-domain projection, role images and descent checks remain unchanged. Search RHS size alone is not proof authority.

The ordinary entrypoint passes lookahead=None. It retains first-direct/first-indirect chronology, source order, seed order and native lifting. The helper returns identical selected proof statistics in this path; the new optional diagnostic staysNone.

Matching nonzero direct rows are withheld from GPLU and later nonzero direct rows are not ranked; the first target-matching indirect pivot ends the search even if its RHS is not smaller. This is a narrow bounded lookahead, not an exhaustive minimum-RHS portfolio.

At review time build-lookahead.py treated /tmp/rustred-direct-hit-lookahead as core root, while it was a full workspace copy. The standalone source/relative diff paths must address crates/rustred-core. Acceptance/root were notified before build.

extra attempted-row cap preserves baseline RHS and sources
